text:
Emma G: escalating from customer — Production error when calling tool via structured_output (function calling). Customer: AcmePay. They hit a 200 but LLM returned an unparsable args payload for tool 'charge_customer'. ticket #5234.

Emma G: Customer payload (what they send to our API):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-ffd-3b",
  "input": "Charge for order 9832",
  "function_call": {
    "name": "charge_customer",
    "arguments": "{\"customer_id\":\"acct_123\",\"amount\":100,}"
  }
}
```

Emma G: error shown in customer logs: `parse_error: invalid JSON in function arguments: trailing comma at position 58`

Raj P: thanks — does the same happen if they set `structured_output: false`?

Emma G: quick test from them: when they toggle structured_output off, assistant replies with a plain text action and no tool call, so their flow breaks. They need function/tool calling.

Mike L: can you paste the full response from our API (the assistant message we returned)? Need to see if we produced the malformed string or if the model returned invalid formatting.

Emma G: pasted assistant msg from our response body: 
```json
{
  "id": "msg_abc",
  "role": "assistant",
  "content": {
    "type": "tool_call",
    "name": "charge_customer",
    "arguments": "{\"customer_id\":\"acct_123\",\"amount\":100,}"
  }
}
```

Emma G: So the assistant.arguments string contains a trailing comma. Customer says this is intermittent (~10% of calls) and correlates with requests that have long prompt context (>= 1200 tokens).

Raj P: seems like schema drift during streaming/concat of tokens. Could be our streaming truncation or the model hallucinating a trailing comma. Any latency or error spikes in logs when this happens?

Emma G: customer timestamps included: failures cluster during high-p99 latency (3.1s -> 8.7s). They attached a stack trace showing our runtime returned 200 and then our parser failed to decode the tool args at parse layer.

Mike L: requesting eng-runtime to check whether stringify of arguments is being buffered incorrectly when KV cache hits or when we apply prefix caching. @eng-runtime-bot can you take?

eng-runtime-bot: Created an issue: RNW-issues/876. Assigned to raj.p and mike.l. Please attach request_id and raw token stream.

Raj P: Emma — can you add the request_id from the customer's last failing call? Also need the exact sequence of prompts (redact PII) and `model_config` including `max_tokens` and `temperature` — trying to reproduce locally.

Emma G: provided request_id: req_20260310_9f3a and trimmed prompt (attached in ticket). model_config: redwood-ffd-3b, structured_output: true, max_tokens: 512, temperature: 0.0.

Mike L: repro attempt notes: I ran 50 calls locally with same config and 2 calls produced trailing comma in arguments (replicated). On our dev logs the assistant emitted tokens: `..., \"amount\":100,}` — the model emitted both comma and closing brace. Looks like tokenization boundary cut the final whitespace so post-processing didn't clean it up.

Mike L: quick mitigation: in our function arg parser we can attempt a tolerant parse — try to auto-fix common issues (remove trailing commas, fix single quotes, unescape sequences) before returning parse_error. This would make customer flows resilient while we root cause the model output.

Raj P: agree. Need a small patch and test vector. Severity: customer-facing payments flow — P1 for support. Emma, can you propose a communication to AcmePay offering a temporary workaround (client-side pre-parse step + server-side tolerant parsing) while we roll a fix?

Emma G: suggested message: "We're investigating. Temporary workaround: 1) if you receive a parse_error, retry once — many failures are transient; 2) apply a small pre-parse on your side to strip trailing commas from the function arguments string; 3) we've opened an internal fix and will notify when deployed." Thoughts?

Raj P: fine. Mike — estimate for patch?

Mike L: I can push a hotfix branch to add tolerant parsing in the request validation layer today. QA + canary by EOD tomorrow. Will also add logging to capture exact token stream for failures so eng-ml can retrain prompt templates if needed.

Emma G: customer wants an ETA for the workaround deployed on their Dedicated cluster. They're also asking whether this could be causing billing disputes when charge attempts fail.

Raj P: we'll coordinate with sales/CS. Emma — mark ticket as P1 and set expectation: tolerant parsing roll-out (canary) in ~24h, full rollout 48–72h, and interim client-side instructions. Also ask customer to enable debug logs (they agreed).

Emma G: updating ticket now. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Mike L: follow-ups: add unit tests for common malformed outputs, and a small prompt guard that discourages trailing commas in function argument completions. I'll file RNW-issues/877 for ML prompt guard.

Emma G: noted. Closing loop with customer after patch.
